first_read_without_control_label: A woman touches a towering upright wall of sea water beside a coastal railway platform at sunset. Concentric rings surround her hand. The water wall and its scale are the immediate image impression.

tests.evidence: Frozen snapshot override is surreal=3 only; saved sensual=1 fetish=0 creativity=1 remain bound. This is technical metadata, separate from perceived strength.
The enormous upright water plane occupies the left and upper field and determines the first impression; the human is a scale reference. One spatial impossibility leads, independently of prop count.
Owned shoulder/elbow/wrist/hand chain reaches a water boundary, with concentric ripple center aligned to hand contact in the same frame.

A vertical water wall and normal ocean behind the platform are clear, but a single continuous ninety-degree joining bend between them is not visible. The image also admits a separate water-sheet or aquarium-wall reading, so the stronger continuous-sea claim does not pass.

The visible face keeps large dark eyes, a small nose and soft lips with a short dark jaw-length bob and fine separated bangs corresponding to the portrait guide. The new head angle and lighting are authored variations; this assessment does not establish identity.

technical_review_separate: The exact derived embodiment checklist can pass while the separately preregistered continuous-water test fails.
